relationships.subject: galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: the incidence of premonitory symptoms that were followed by headache decreased by 48% in the 27 responders vs. 28% in the 19 non-responders

relationships.subject: galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: the number of triggers followed by headache decreased by 38% in responders vs. 13% in non-responders

relationships.subject: galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: Note that the percentage of migraine days per month decreased significantly, although to a different extent, in all 3 groups

key_findings: Galcanezumab reduced headache following premonitory symptoms, auras and triggers more in responders and super-responders than in non-responders.
Even a mild decrease in migraine frequency may partially reverse excitability of neurons involved in triggers and premonitory symptoms.
